newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -June JGB seen poised to test support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -June JGB seen poised to test support.

text.p: Key June JGB futures contract is likely to test its support due to the need to hedge against corporate bonds which have been launched massively in the past few weeks, traders said on Tuesday.

"The recent flattening of the yield curve urged corporations to tap longer maturities, hurting both futures prices and the longer-end of the cash JGBs," said a senior trader at a city banks's brokerage arm.
A total of 420 billion yen worth of corporate issues were launched last week. Demand for such bonds was detected, but most investors were waiting for bargain-hunting chances.
"It's not that they (investors) are loath to buy corporate bonds, but they are waiting for prices and yields to become more reasonable," the senior trader said.
A chart support for the June at 126.50 has been breached on Monday and the market is seen ready to test the next support at 125.80, traders said.
There is more to come in the corporate bond market.
Tokyo Electric Power Co is expected to launch 100 billion to 150 billion yen worth of bonds later this week and Japan Airlines Co is also set for a 70 billion yen bond issue on Tuesday.
